sources.title: Original practical decision prompts
sources.supports: Logging categories, identifying constraints, recording context and asking clear questions.
sources.limits: These prompts do not establish training effectiveness, safety, causal effects or time savings.

sources.title: Explicitly invented arithmetic and chart examples
sources.supports: (3-2)/2=50%; 3-2=1. Scores 90 and 100 remain unchanged when an axis minimum changes.
sources.limits: No measured fitness outcome; all such graphics must carry an invented-example label.

sources.title: Schoenfeld et al. (2016), Longer Interset Rest Periods Enhance Muscle Strength and Hypertrophy in Resistance-Trained Men
sources.supports: 21 young resistance-trained men; randomized 1-minute versus 3-minute rest; eight weeks. Greater squat and bench 1RM improvement in the longer-rest group. Pre/post testing.
sources.limits: Small, specific population and program. Not an individual forecast or universal rest-duration prescription. Full-text risk-of-bias review not completed. M04 and M12 require final editorial review.

sources.title: Amanuma et al. (2025), Comparable regional hypertrophy of the knee extensor muscles in response to resistance training with machines versus free weights
sources.supports: Eight young previously untrained women; nine weeks; within-person lunge versus inclined leg press; comparable hypertrophy in measured thigh regions.
sources.limits: Eight participants, not sixteen independent people. No proof of universal exercise equivalence. Full-text appraisal not completed; M07 requires final editorial review.

sources.title: YouTube: Understand your content performance
sources.supports: Shorts engaged views, stayed-to-watch, average view duration and average percentage viewed have distinct definitions.
sources.limits: Do not infer an engaged-view denominator from public starts; keep platform exports and definitions with each observation.

sources.title: Meta: About text overlays and the safe zone
sources.access: carried forward from 2026-10-21 V3 targeted review; not newly fetched in this pass
sources.supports: Conservative ad-safe layout proxy used in existing project.
sources.limits: Organic UI varies; final uploader preview remains necessary. No guarantee for every device or caption length.

sources.title: Noetel et al. Multimedia Design for Learning: An Overview of Reviews With Meta-Meta-Analysis
sources.access: carried forward from V3 abstract review
sources.supports: Signaling, coherence, segmentation and spatial/temporal contiguity motivate readable explanatory motion.
sources.limits: Learning evidence does not demonstrate Shorts retention gains; application here is an editorial hypothesis.
